rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for things connected with official oversight or regulation, especially in business and finance.

example.english: This bank has to follow the regulatory requirements before it can launch a new product.
example.traditional: 呢間銀行要跟足監管要求，先可以推出新產品。

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on rules or requirements imposed to control an activity, rather than on the body supervising it.

example.english: The government uses new regulatory laws to control online lending and protect borrowers.
example.traditional: 政府用新法例規管網上放貸，保障借款人。
